risk_profile: balanced optimization candidate; not final live preset

expected_effect.trade_count: between Candidate A 111 and Candidate B 72
expected_effect.quality_goal: profit factor above 1.20, max drawdown below 12 percent, return above 5 percent

notes: Candidate C is the most logical next adjustment because Candidate A failed only on drawdown and Candidate B failed only on profit factor.
